column1: # frame-grounding.tsv -- the frame-conformance gate's grounding table (rd vms-ci.6).
# One row per FIELD of a frame type OVMX sends to a real node. Every byte of
# every frame the gate's host tests emit must be covered by exactly one row
# that applies to it; tools/cluster/frame_conformance.py fails on an uncovered
# byte, on a value outside its rule, and on a row with no evidence.
#   type      frame type, as the emitting test names it (conformance_dump.h)
#   select    which frames the row applies to: * or op=<hex> (MSCP opcode, abs 80)
#   off,len   ABSOLUTE frame offset and length (little-endian value)
#   class     const | copied | derived | minted | deviation
#   rule      const:<hex> (LE value; 0 = all-zero for spans > 8)  bytes:<hex>  set:<hex>,<hex>..  state:<key> (equals the emitting
#             lo16 0x0001..0x0010)  any:<why> (a value with no envelope of
#             its own, checked by the named test)
#   evidence  the census / capture / test that grounds it. A `deviation` row
#             is an OVMX value OUTSIDE the real envelope that real VAXes are
#             recorded accepting; the gate reports every one it passes.
# Real envelopes: tools/cluster/minted_form_census.py and the per-field census
# ---- MSCP command SYSAP body (abs 72..107), class driver + join walk -------
